description: MCP servers that expose a tool with this exact name (e.g. send_email, web_search, create_issue), as read from the live servers by the Serverdex check. Most-starred first, at most 3 per publisher. Returns slug, name, publisher, category, stars, whether it answered the last live check, and how that server describes the tool. Only names shipped by 8+ publishers are indexed; use search_servers for anything else.

name.description: The tool name, lower-case, as the server exposes it: send_email, search, get_weather.

title: Find servers by tool name
